backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260513-014 policy semantics.

before_variant.target_definition: official Space customer_win source profile and peer momentum leader

best_variant.target_definition: government_space_contract event profile and peer momentum leader

decision_rationale: The government-contract plus peer-leader scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe. Event profiles and peer-state fields are production-visible, but any accepted Space change must remain default-off until forward evidence matures.

accepted_multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

peer_momentum_state.source: accepted Space basket momentum enrichment from exp-20260511-115 stack

runtime_fields: space_peer_momentum_state from accepted Space signal enrichment

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale official Space government-contract signals only when they are peer momentum leaders.

2_history_check.exp-20260512-040: Rejected broad defense-budget source scalar because drawdown cost exceeded Gate 4. This run adds the peer-leader condition and includes official NASA/government contract profiles.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-944: Rejected primary-authority customer-source scalar. This run uses a different event field, government_space_contract, and requires peer leadership.
2_history_check.exp-20260513-002: Rejected customer-win hard pool pruning. This run keeps the pool fixed and changes only risk allocation.
2_history_check.exp-20260513-014: Accepted customer-source peer-leader 1.10x helper; this is the fixed before state and is not retuned.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_government_contract_peer_leader_risk_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space stack, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL versus exp-014 accepted stack, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 total trades, nonzero adjusted signals, and non-1.0 scalar.

hypothesis: Space replacement value should be stronger when an official government contract catalyst lines up with in-basket relative strength. Broad defense-budget source scaling had too much drawdown cost, so this tests the narrower production-visible intersection without changing pool membership, rankings, exits, LLM/news logic, or live slots.
interpretation: The government-contract plus peer-leader scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space soft-ranking remains label-limited; this run uses deterministic production-visible government-contract and peer-momentum metadata.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not promote government-contract peer-leader scaling on these frozen snapshots. Future Space alpha should either wait for closed forward replacement value by catalyst/source bucket or test another production-visible catalyst-quality field with broader coverage.
